speaker: john_heminges
text: Thirty-eight shillings, Will. Your share, after Titus. I have it on the sheet. I am not rounding it to look like last week.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thirty-eight. Last week was forty-five. I am not asking you for a tale about the difference, and I am not ruling a total under it.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: You were in it today. The old Roman, off in the fourth. I saw you come off. This is the reckoning after the play.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I was in it. Monday, Wednesday, and today. Three afternoons, one share. I do not want a wage for having stayed into the fifth.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The comedy was Thursday. The gowns were thick. I am not making that a sum. The week had a loud day that was not the king.

speaker: john_heminges
text: I am not turning a loud day into a second figure. Thirty-eight shillings is the figure. Say it back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thirty-eight shillings. My share. It goes in the book as a share.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The king was Tuesday. You were Gaunt, and you were done by the middle. The next is Thursday the sixteenth. The hired men are on their ten, and that was settled before this week. I am not opening it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave it settled. Tuesday was the second time the king has been played, and the first of those was Thursday last. This paper wants Tuesday, and thirty-eight, and nothing clever beside them.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Thursday the second, then Tuesday, then the sixteenth. I have it so. The Rose is not on this paper.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: The Rose has 1 Hercules up today. I read the title. I did not go, and he did not either.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it off the sheet. I do not know their house. I will not invent one to explain forty-five against thirty-eight.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The glass stayed in the chest. Nobody called for it. I am saying so because the king was played, and someone always asks.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nobody called for it. It stays locked. That is the chest's business, and Abel's. It is not this paper's.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Locked, then. I will not put a glass on a share sheet. Thirty-eight shillings. Are we done?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We are done. The share, and nothing under it. I can say it without a joke. Last week the joke was refused at forty-five. It can be refused at a smaller sum.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Refuse it, then. The jaw has had three deaths and a comedy's worth of vowels. That is enough for a Saturday.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: Enough. John has the sheet. You have the share. None of this needs a song.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Then write the line and go home. No total. The king on this paper is Tuesday. Titus is done.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: 1 Hercules is their afternoon. Ours was Titus, and you were in it. I am not pairing the houses to make the thirty-eight look thin.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not pair them. I do not know what their house took, and I will not guess it onto this sheet.

speaker: augustine_phillips
text: The hired men's ten was Saturday last. Settled. I am saying it once so it does not wander into today's line.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Once is enough. It is not in the thirty-eight, and it is not coming out of the thirty-eight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. Forty-five was last week, with the joke refused. Thirty-eight is this week, with the joke refused again. The coffer stays as it was counted.

speaker: john_heminges
text: As it was counted. I am not asking you for a new sum of the whole. The share is the share. Go and write the line.
